title: Add global error toast UI and handlers
message: Introduce a reusable global error/toast system: add a React GlobalErrorToast component (with CSS) and replace the simple window.onerror in index.html with a more robust IIFE that renders animated glassmorphism toasts, throttles/folds duplicates, shows a progress bar, and handles unhandled promise rejections. Add test buttons on the MainPage to trigger runtime and script errors for QA. Also bump src/version.json to the new deploy hash/date.
